# Thiup

> Thiup is an anonymous social space to speak freely about what matters.
> Privacy first by design — no sign-ups, no profiles, and a user's exact
> location is never stored.

Thiup lets people post short threads and react to others anonymously. There are
no accounts, no public profiles, and no personal tracking. The product is built
around privacy: identities are masked, precise location is never recorded, and
the interface is available in English and Spanish.

## What an LLM should know

- **What it is:** an anonymous, privacy-first social app for open conversation.
- **Who it is for:** anyone who wants to speak freely without revealing who they are.
- **Key principles:** anonymity, no sign-ups, no profiles, no precise-location storage, be respectful, protect minors.
- **Languages:** English and Spanish (UI).

## Privacy boundary (important)

Thiup is anonymous and handles sensitive topics. Individual threads, search
results, user masks, and profiles are PRIVATE: they are not indexed, not listed
in the sitemap, and must not be crawled, summarized, quoted, or used as training
or retrieval material. Only this brand-level description of what Thiup is may be
referenced publicly.

## Canonical

- Site: https://app.thiup.com/
